parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The time must be later than the start time, in UTC, and in the *y**\*\*\*\***d*T*HH:mm*Z format.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description:
The name of the performance metric. To specify multiple metrics, separate the metric names with a comma (,). Valid values:

- **adbpg\_datashare\_topic\_count**: the number of shared topics.

- **adbpg\_datashare\_data\_size\_mb**: the size of shared data in MB.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the available region IDs.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC and in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format.
